responsibility: This file implements an AArch64 RTL optimization pass for Qualcomm Falkor that renames load destination registers in loops to avoid hardware prefetch-tag collisions. It analyzes loads, computes Falkor-specific prefetch tags from destination/base/offset encodings, groups colliding loads by tag, uses regrename def-use information to avoid breaking related chains, and then tries to rename loads so unrelated streams are distributed across different hardware prefetchers, exposing the pass as make_pass_tag_collision_avoidance.
